CustomField.description: Formula: expected sod roll count using snapshot fields. Same-object calculation — no cross-object references. Expected_Sod_Square_Footage__c / Expected_Sod_Roll_Coverage__c, fallback 9 SF per roll if coverage blank or zero. Snapshot fields populated by LOVING_Delivery_QC_Submit at DQC creation. PKG-DQC-PARENT-01b.
CustomField.formula: IF( Sod_Included__c = TRUE, ROUND( Expected_Sod_Square_Footage__c / IF( OR( ISBLANK(Expected_Sod_Roll_Coverage__c), Expected_Sod_Roll_Coverage__c = 0 ), 9, Expected_Sod_Roll_Coverage__c ), 0 ), 0 )
CustomField.label: Sod Rolls Expected
